## Gate Check

- [ ] Inquiry has a named person, company, and specific ask.
- [ ] `docs/monetization-v3/galaxy-partnership-evaluation-framework.md` was applied before any call was scheduled.
- [ ] If legal obligation is possible, lawyer review is required before signing or sending terms.
- [ ] If Live-specific, the Live track activation gate is cleared or the inquiry is deferred.

## Category

- [ ] A - Direct competitor
- [ ] B - Sportsbook, US-licensed
- [ ] C - Sportsbook, offshore / unlicensed
- [ ] D - Media outlet
- [ ] E - Podcast / streamer
- [ ] F - Software vendor
- [ ] G - B2B data buyer
- [ ] H - Acquisition / investment
